summary: Wall-clock test_ac5 benchmark is opt-in via PANTHEON_RUN_PERSIST_COST_BENCHMARK=1 (skipped with a reason otherwise); benchmark function and thresholds unchanged. Default CI path has two deterministic AC5 tests using _full_persist_count/_delta_persist_count only: (a) test_ac5_deterministic_4mb_store_full_rewrites_before_and_after (store.project_event heartbeats) and (b) test_ac5_deterministic_full_call_mix_full_rewrites_before_and_after, which runs run_local_persist_cost_benchmark() with time.sleep patched out so the full AC5 call mix (ingest + infrastructure-health + runtime-summaries GET + readyz GET) is exercised; asserts after<=1 full rewrite and legacy full rewrites >= number of ingests.
